items.mainDefect: getClientsWithPermission uses findByType(server, "Clients"), but per-client resources have no type, so it never finds permissions on individual clients.

secondary.defect: When the type-level permission grants the scope, the literal resource name "Clients" is added as a client id, which makes the caller AvailableRoleMappingResource.getRoleIdsWithPermissions throw a NullPointerException on realm.getClientById(cid).

items.mainDefect: The test grants CONFIGURE, MAP_ROLES and MAP_ROLES_COMPOSITE together, so it can pass even when the MAP_ROLES / MAP_ROLES_COMPOSITE evaluation is broken, because CONFIGURE alone also allows some role paths.

secondary.defect: No test grants MAP_ROLES_COMPOSITE without MAP_ROLES, or MAP_ROLES without MAP_ROLES_COMPOSITE, to check that each scope is evaluated on its own.
